body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies within 5 units and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each takes 1 Necrotic Damage and becomes Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Increase the Slow on one target to 2.
Each hit target suffers -1 Composure against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Hex
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: on a hit, choose one target to become Possessed. Trigger: it voluntarily ends movement adjacent to another enemy. Echo: both are Distracted until your next turn.
